news.title: 'Helpless 1-3 Defeat to Ghana': South Korea's U20 Women's Football Team Faces Elimination from World Cup Group Stage
news.lede: The South Korea U-20 women's national football team has been pushed to the brink of elimination from the group stage of the 2026 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup. Led by head coach Park Yoon-jung, the South Korea U-20 national team suffered a decisive 1-3 defeat to Ghana in the Group C second match of the tournament held at Sosnowiec Arena in Poland at 10 p.m. (Korean time) on the 9th. Earlier, South Korea had drawn 1-1 with France, finishing the group stage with one draw and one loss (one point), placing them last in their group.

news.title: Meet the six people grilling Thomas Tuchel over England's gut-wrenching World Cup exit
news.lede: England boss Thomas Tuchel will stand in front of a six-person panel when he meets with the FA's performance advisory board. The group includes a rugby league legend and a former Premier League player. The international break will soon be upon us and this hiatus will last an extended three weeks. During this period, the Three Lions will play four Nations League matches, their first outings since July's bitter World Cup semi-final defeat.

news.title: FIFA World Cup-winning legend Cafu launches North Bengal Fighters FC & Darjeeling Warriors FC
news.lede: VMPL Darjeeling (West Bengal) [India], September 9: Brazilian football legend and two-time FIFA World Cup winner Cafu launched North Bengal Fighters FC and Darjeeling Warriors FC in Darjeeling, marking the beginning of a new initiative aimed at identifying and nurturing footballing talent from the hills and North Bengal. Speaking about the initiative, Viraaj Bansal, Director of Arya Tea Company Limited and owner of both clubs, said “The two clubs, promoted by Arya Tea Company Limited, will have dedicated academies focused on youth development and are expected to provide young footballers with a structured pathway from grassroots football to competitive state, national and international opportunities.” The launch was held in the presence of Cafu and ministers of the West Bengal government.

news.title: Football: Lionel Messi reaches 'preliminary agreement' to buy Eldense
news.lede: Messi won the World Cup with Argentina in 2022. Spanish second-division side Eldense say Argentina great Lionel Messi has reached a "preliminary agreement" to become the club's majority shareholder. Eldense will become the second Spanish club Messi has invested in, having bought Catalan side Cornella in April. The 39-year-old former Barcelona forward currently plays for Inter Miami and recently retired from international football after Argentina were beaten 1-0 by Spain in the 2026 World Cup final.

news.title: Dani Olmo: ‘Winning the World Cup changes you, it changes your life’
news.lede: One of Barcelona’s eight World Cup winners reflects on how Spain’s triumph is inspiring them in the Champions League. Dani Olmo nods towards his right arm. “Look: goosebumps,” he says. The Spain midfielder is sitting in a back room at Barcelona’s Joan Gamper training ground trying to pinpoint the moment he knew he was a world champion.
